conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Office of Investigations. This is Agent Peterson speaking. How may I assist you?
Hello, I received a message that there is an urgent issue with my taxes. I was told to call this number.
Thank you for calling back. I see your file here. There are discrepancies in your tax filings for the past two years, which have triggered a federal audit.
I'm sorry, I don't understand. I hired someone to handle my taxes. Is there a problem with my return?
According to section 7201 of the IRS code, you are currently listed as a primary suspect in willful tax evasion. There is now an outstanding balance of $3,214, plus penalties.
Willful tax evasion? I don't even know what that means. I thought everything was correct.
Due to the severity of these allegations, we have already issued a warrant for your arrest. Your professional license and work permit are also at risk of suspension.
Wait, what? I can lose my work permit? I can be arrested?
Yes, unless you resolve this matter with the IRS immediately. If you fail to comply, the authorities will arrive at your address within two hours and your assets may be frozen.
Please, I don't want any trouble. What do I need to do to fix this?
We can offer you an out-of-court settlement to cancel the warrant and clear your name, but this must be completed today.
How do I do that?
First, I need you to confirm your identity. Can you verify your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security Number?
Okay, my date of birth is December 4, 1985, and the last four digits are 1482.
Thank you. Now, for the payment, the IRS requires you to settle the amount using either a wire transfer or by purchasing government-approved payment vouchers.
What are government-approved vouchers? I've never heard of that.
They are prepaid cards you can purchase at authorized retailers, such as Target or Walgreens. Once you have the cards, you give me the codes on the back to process your settlement.
So I need to go out and buy these cards? How much do I have to get?
You need to buy cards totaling $3,214. You can split this across several cards if necessary. If you do not complete this within the next 40 minutes, the warrant will proceed.
I... I can try. I'm really confused, is there no other way?
This is the only way to halt the legal process. Once you have the cards, do not speak with anyone at the store about the reason. It is a federal matter.
Okay, I understand. Should I call you back after I get the cards?
No, remain on the line with me while you purchase them. Are you able to leave for the store now?
Yes, I can go now, but I'm still very nervous.
As long as you cooperate, there will be no arrest or license suspension. Let me know when you reach the store.
Alright, I'm leaving now. Please stay on the line.
